claim_boundary: Original Conichnus-inspired negative conical cavity penetrating thick sediment, converging to a small rounded basal termination. No almond resting trace, named tracemaker, behavior, location or specimen-copy claim.

interpretation_correction: Freeze opening diameter .084 m in .24 x .20 x .14 m sediment; cavity depth .112 m and small rounded basal termination. Preserve negative cavity; no almond outline. Published KGS genus description gives rounded base; specific C. conicus may have small planar apical disc. Therefore pointed-bottom means strongly converging narrow base, not unsupported mathematically sharp point. Supplement exact-GLB gray top and oblique with a labelled diagnostic half-section; main delivered GLB remains intact.
